results.title: After the Ashes
results.overview: Leonor joins a contemporary dance company to unravel the mystery of Oraison, a mythical piece performed by her mother thirty years ago, in the hope of understanding what shattered her. She discovers a ritual in which every gesture summons up the ghosts of the past and reopens the wounds of a lineage.

results.title: Dusk
results.overview: When a series of unexplained events begin to echo across time, one woman finds herself at the center of a threat that refuses to stay buried. As the past bleeds into the present, she is forced to confront a presence that seems to follow her across lives, memories, and moments she can’t fully explain.  DUSK is a psychological horror film that blends suspense and supernatural elements, exploring the idea that some darkness doesn’t end—it returns. Starring Laura Bailey (Critical Role), alongside Bruce DuBose and Todd Haberkorn, the film delivers a character-driven descent into fear, where survival means recognizing what’s been hunting you all along.

results.title: Sarpanch
results.overview: For the last two decades, in the rural heartlands of Punjab, the elected leadership of a small village has done nothing to develop the community, instead engaging in corrupt and harmful practices. To save his home and combat pressing issues, Fateh steps up to take charge and run for the position of Sarpanch (village head), which forces him to confront intense opposition.

results.title: Betty's Revenge
results.overview: Three college seniors venture to the abandoned Dizzy Dishes cabaret club while researching its fiery past. They encounter the former owner, Betty — who claims to be half woman, half “something else.”

results.title: Selah
results.overview: When Selah, a determined teen, takes on a solo road trip from Texas to California to deliver a designer puppy for cash, both her responsibilities and emotions get tested to the limit, ultimately revealing her real reason for the trip.

results.title: Flavinho de Papai
results.overview: People who have never had to do real work want to convince you that the best approach is to cut investments for those who are out there grinding every day.  Flávio Bolsonaro—who was accused of being a "ghost employee" in Jair’s office at the age of 19 and has always lived off his father—wants to cut the very things that have helped millions of Brazilians get ahead in life: social security, healthcare, education, the *Bolsa Família* welfare program, and labor rights.  This is the man who wants to be president of Brazil. If Flávio wins, you lose.

results.title: Special Day
results.overview: The daughter's first birthday, and everything has to be perfect: the dresses fit, the garden gleams. But behind the façade, things are crumbling. For weeks, Ana has planned this party as if it could save her from her own exhaustion. A feminist commentary on the patriarchal conventions of the new-old upper class: as neatly pressed on the outside as it is sour-tempered underneath.

results.title: Die Tauben
results.overview: Partly driven by curiosity, partly frozen in shock, a crowd of onlookers gathers around a car accident. Unable and, in some cases, unwilling to intervene, the audience ignores the imminent danger above them, which threatens to bury them all beneath it.

results.title: HalloWiebe: Overdrive
results.overview: When Wiebe and his team of security guards have to stop a thief from stealing an amusement park's most valuable attraction, they quickly learn this new villain is stronger than they could have imagined.

results.title: The Trouble With Mistletoe
results.overview: An acquisitions executive who returns home for Christmas and unexpectedly reconnects with the former fiancé she left behind. As the traditions of her hometown rekindle old memories, she begins to wonder if the life she walked away from may still be the one meant for her.

results.title: #WhileBlack
results.overview: Centers on one of the most viral videos of our time: George Floyd’s murder, seen 1.4 billion times in 12 days, sparking protests in over 2,000 cities worldwide. With exclusive access to Darnella Frazier and others like Diamond Reynolds, who livestreamed Philando Castile’s killing, the film reveals how social platforms and corporations profit from viral Black trauma, while survivors endure lasting psychological and physical danger.

results.title: The Metropolitan Opera: Così fan tutte
results.original_title: The Metropolitan Opera: Così fan tutte

results.title: hey, pumpkin.
results.overview: After her recent marriage proposal, Dani’s night spirals into spilled coffee, unwanted advice, and relentless advertisements that seem to know her greatest fears. While picking up her sister from a party gone wrong, both women confront love, adulthood, and the possibility that none of this is as spontaneous as it feels.  This film is not sponsored, endorsed, or associated with the Starbucks Coffee Company.

results.title: Adgwa-Ata
results.overview: Abducted by a jungle tribe to undergo a brutal initiation, three teenage girls enter a divine realm where taming giant snakes – their totem animals – becomes a rite of passage into adulthood.

results.title: Nakhrewaalii
results.overview: Sumit Mishra cross-dresses as a woman to win over his love interest, Paridhi.

results.title: Fracture
results.overview: Keren is a performer, filmmaker, activist. At 20, she left Israel to grow as an artist and person. After eight years in Europe, she feels the need to return to the contradictions she left behind. She joins the rallies against Netanyahu, volunteers with Palestinian families, finds love, keeps filming. The October 7 attack occurs. The war and genocide begin. The fracture keeps deepening.

results.title: Solo Fanáticos
results.overview: The film follows the story of an OnlyFans star who becomes pregnant with a nepobaby, the son of a hotel magnate, and addresses the tensions between love, power, and media exposure.

results.title: Snorp: My Alien Friend 2
results.overview: Continuation of the adventures of the alien, sequel to the film "Zhdun".
